messages:
nina_design: I prototyped two placements for showing schema diffs when a user swaps a tool in the run row: inline collapse vs side panel. attaching gifs: https://redwood.mock/s/inline-vs-side.gif jasper_devex: nice. quick pros/cons? my gut: inline keeps context but can push content down; side panel preserves density but is heavier to invoke. omar_pm: audit / compliance ask: whichever we pick, the run history needs a persistent record of the swap (who changed it, from->to, when). could be a small pill in the run item. lia_a11y: accessibility checklist: focus management when expanding inline diff is critical. for the side panel, ensure it has role=dialog with aria-modal=false (non-blocking) and keyboard trap only for full-screen modal. also need announce text on change: \"Tool changed from X to Y. Press r to rerun.\" ben_engineer: implementation constraints: inline uses less JS but we need to render small diffs compactly (one-line summary + badges). side panel will reuse inspector and show full schema + examples. also network: lazy-load schema on open; cache by function id. zoe_research: we ran a micro-study: people preferred inline for quick edits, side panel for deeper verification. suggestion: default to inline, and offer a \"More details\" affordance that opens the panel. nina_design: copy options for the affordance: - inline button: "Edit tool" / "Change tool" - small summary: "sig: foo(name: string) -> object" - affordance to open panel: "See details" or "Open signature" Which reads best? jasper_devex: "Change tool" feels action-y. prefer "Open signature" for panel link. lia_a11y: microcopy note: avoid icons-only actions without aria-label. for the inline chevron use aria-label=\"Expand signature details\" and aria-expanded state. ben_engineer: code sample we can slot in: ```html
sig: predict(text: string) -> {answer: string}
``` omar_pm: UX policy: do not auto-rerun after swap. show subtle toast: \"Tool updated — rerun to apply\" with a small \"Rerun now\" action. keeps deterministic logs. zoe_research: add a metric: percent of swaps followed by rerun within 30s. helps decide if auto-rerun would be safe. nina_design: updated mock will default to inline summary + chevron + \"Open signature\" that opens side panel. will push updated PNGs. build-bot: build-bot: playground/ui-invoke-swap default branch deployed to staging (build 6311).
